title: One bundle, two owners

scenes.heading: Two teams share one GPU cluster
scenes.sub: Agree on the runtime and workload boundary
voice: The platform team runs the GPU runtime, and another team owns the workload platforms.
They need separate deployment handoffs that agree on the same cluster configuration.

scenes.heading: Split at the component classes
scenes.sub: Keep the full recipe at the root
voice: Use split when generating a Helm bundle.
Core gets the components a basic GPU workload needs, while ops holds workload platforms and other components.

scenes.heading: Pass it over in dependency order
voice: The platform team applies core first so shared prerequisites are available.
Then the workload team applies ops. When the teams tear down the stack, they reverse that order.

scenes.heading: Verify both folders together
voice: Keep the root recipe and inventory with the two folders.
Verification at the set root covers both parts together, including any attestation on the bundle set.

payoff: Split a Helm deployment into two ordered handoffs while retaining a single root for bundle verification.
